page.title: Hugo Panel — a self-hosted Hugo admin panel
page.description: Hugo Panel is a Hugo site admin panel written in Go. Content, themes, modules, media and builds all live in one interface: a single binary plus a single SQLite file, with no Node.js.
hero.title:
Hugo upkeep,
in one quiet backend.
hero.lead: Content, themes, modules, media and builds in a single interface. One binary, one SQLite file — no config files to hand-edit and no terminal required.
phone.title: Installable PWA
phone.sub: Offline app shell · Mobile ready · Add to Home Screen
phone.alt: The Hugo Panel dashboard on an iPhone: menu, language and theme buttons at the top, content stats and a publishing chart below.
showcase.title: See what your site is doing at a glance
showcase.lead: Content totals, publishing rhythm, theme status and recent edits — all visible the moment you open the panel.
showcase.caption: Desktop dashboard · light theme
showcase.alt: Hugo Panel desktop dashboard: navigation on the left, search and language switch on top, content stat cards, a publishing chart and a site overview.
features.title: Everything you would reach for the CLI to do
features.lead: Built for day-to-day writing and upkeep, not for memorising config files.
f.content.title: Content
f.content.body: Create, rename, search, filter and page through Markdown pages and posts. Front matter supports YAML / TOML / JSON, with live preview alongside.
f.theme.title: Themes
f.theme.body: List and enable the themes in themes/, or install, update and remove them from Git. Site params and menus are edited visually.
f.module.title: Modules
f.module.body: Install and remove Hugo Modules, run hugo mod tidy, and see the command output and toolchain status right in the panel.
f.media.title: Media library
f.media.body: Upload, preview and delete images, then copy a URL or Markdown link in one click. JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF and ICO up to 20 MB.
f.build.title: Builds
f.build.body: Run hugo --gc --minify --cleanDestinationDir from the panel, keep the last result, and get an email if a build fails.
f.i18n.title: Languages
f.i18n.body: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese and Korean. Each is a separate file loaded on demand, and you can upload your own.
f.dark.title: Light and true black
f.dark.body: Follows the system by default. The dark theme uses a pure black #000 background, so OLED pixels stay off and the battery lasts longer.
f.security.title: Security
f.security.body: HttpOnly sessions, CSRF protection, rate-limited login and password reset, same-origin checks, CSP and path-traversal guards, with automatic config backups.
start.title: Start with one command
start.lead: Images are published for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. The first visit opens the admin setup wizard.
note.mounts.title: Two volumes
note.mounts.body: /app/hugo-panel/data holds the SQLite database, backups and custom translations; /app/hugo is your Hugo site.
note.https.title: HTTPS required
note.https.body: Outside localhost, installing the PWA and its service worker requires HTTPS. Put it behind a reverse proxy and set PUBLIC_URL.
note.perm.title: Container user
note.perm.body: Runs as UID/GID 1000 and chowns the mounted volumes on startup. Disable that when an external tool manages permissions.
closing.title: Deploy it, then forget about config files.
closing.body: Source, docs and issue tracker live on GitHub. The project is open source under the MIT license.
